title: Lulu and the Little Nest | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Little Bird needs a nest, so Lulu the little duck helps. One, two, three twigs!
Little Bird carries them up to the branch, one by one, and makes a cosy nest. Tweet, tweet!
Then the sun goes down, and Little Bird and Lulu fall asleep under the tree.
A gentle story about helping friends, for children aged 3 to 6.
